     5	## 1. Project Manifest — Start Here!
     6	
     7	> **This is a sizable codebase (1,545+ class files).** A single monolithic manifest cannot cover it.
     8	> Cross-cutting concerns live in the Project Manifest; module-specific architecture is maintained
     9	> separately in the `/.context/` folder via the CTX Generator tool.
    10	
    11	**Manifest location:** `docs/agents/project-manifest/`
    12	
    13	| Document | Description |
    14	|---|---|
    15	| [README.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/README.md) | Manifest index and orientation. **Read this first.** |
    16	| [context-documentation.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/context-documentation.md) | Two-tier documentation strategy: manifest + CTX module docs, `.context/` layout. |
    17	| [constraints.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md) | Coding rules, naming conventions, architectural patterns, non-obvious gotchas. |
    18	| [testing.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/testing.md) | Test infrastructure, suites, base classes, and execution commands. |
    19	| [modules-overview.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/modules-overview.md) | Auto-generated list of all modules. Regenerated by `composer build`. |
    20	| [module-glossary.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/module-glossary.md) | Auto-generated glossary: opaque domain terms → modules. Regenerated by `composer build`. |
    21	
    22	### Quick Start Workflow
    23	
    24	1. **Read** [context-documentation.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/context-documentation.md) — understand how knowledge is structured.
    25	2. **Read** [constraints.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md) — internalize coding conventions and patterns.
    26	3. **Read** [testing.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/testing.md) — learn how to run and scope tests.
    27	4. **Read** `.context/` files for module-specific architecture.
    28	5. **Fall back to source code** only when the documentation does not cover the specific detail needed.
    29	
    30	### CTX-Generated Documentation (`.context/`)
    31	
    32	The `.context/` folder is in the **project root** and is generated by the [CTX Generator](https://github.com/context-hub/generator) from `context.yaml` configuration files distributed throughout the codebase. Regenerate with `composer build` (which includes autoload dump, module docs, and CTX generation as its final step).
    33	
    34	> **Note:** `.context/` is committed to VCS so that agent search tools can discover its contents.
    35	> After running the build, commit the updated generated files.
    36	
    37	**Root-level documents:**
    38	
    39	| File | Contents |
    40	|---|---|
    41	| `.context/framework-core-system-overview.md` | Agent coding guidelines, patterns, exception usage, file/JSON/array handling, UI localization. |
    42	| `.context/framework-file-structure.md` | Full annotated class file tree. |
    43	
    44	**Module documents (`.context/modules/`):**
    45	
    46	| Module | Path |
    47	|---|---|
    48	| AI Tools | `.context/modules/ai/` |
    49	| API OpenAPI | `.context/modules/openapi/` |
    50	| Application Sets | `.context/modules/application-sets/` |
    51	| Composer | `.context/modules/composer/` |
    52	| Connectors | `.context/modules/connectors/` |
    53	| DB Helper | `.context/modules/db-helper/` |
    54	| Event Handler | `.context/modules/event-handler/` |
    55	| UI | `.context/modules/ui/` (sub-modules: `admin-urls/`, `bootstrap/`, `client-resources/`, `datagrid/`, `form/`, `markup-editor/`, `page/`, `properties-grid/`, `themes/`, `tree/`) |
    56	
    57	Each module folder typically contains `overview.md`, `architecture-core.md`, `file-structure.md`, and other aspect-specific files. Read `overview.md` first when investigating a module.
    58	
    59	### Additional Documentation
    60	
    61	| Location | Contents |
    62	|---|---|
    63	| [docs/agents/](docs/agents/readme.md) | Agent coding guidelines, patterns, and conventions. |
    64	| [docs/agents/plans/](docs/agents/plans/) | Dated implementation plans for features in progress. |
    65	| [docs/agents/references/](docs/agents/references/) | Reference documentation for module context configuration. |
    66	| [docs/agents/whatsnew-editing.md](docs/agents/whatsnew-editing.md) | Guide for maintaining the XML version changelog (`WHATSNEW.xml`). |
    67	| [docs/sql/](docs/sql/) | Database schema SQL files. |
    68	
    69	---
    70	
    71	## 2. Manifest Maintenance Rules
    72	
    73	| Change Made | Documents to Update |
    74	|---|---|
    75	| New module added | `module-context.yaml` (add module context), run `composer build`, update module table above |
    76	| Module restructured | Module's `module-context.yaml`, run `composer build` |
    77	| New coding convention established | `docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md` |
    78	| Testing infrastructure changed | `docs/agents/project-manifest/testing.md` |
    79	| New dependency added/removed | `composer.json`, run `composer dump-autoload` |
    80	| Directory structure changed | Run `composer build` to refresh `.context/framework-file-structure.md` |
    81	| Documentation strategy changed | `docs/agents/project-manifest/context-documentation.md` |
    82	| Database schema changed | `docs/sql/` |
    83	| New class file added/renamed | Run `composer dump-autoload` (classmap autoloading) |
    84	
    85	---
    86	
    87	## 3. Efficiency Rules — Search Smart
    88	
    89	This codebase has **1,545+ class files**. Wasteful scanning is expensive. Follow this lookup order:
    90	
    91	1. **Finding files?** Check `.context/framework-file-structure.md` or the module's `file-structure.md` FIRST.
    92	2. **Understanding a module?** Read the module's `.context/` `overview.md` and `architecture-core.md` FIRST.
    93	3. **Unfamiliar domain term?** Check `docs/agents/project-manifest/module-glossary.md` to map the term to the relevant module(s) before searching the codebase.
    94	4. **Coding patterns?** Check `docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md` and `docs/agents/coding-patterns.md` FIRST.
    95	5. **Only then** read source files.
    96

   134	## 6. Testing Quick Reference
   135	
   136	Full documentation: [testing.md](docs/agents/project-manifest/testing.md)
   137	
   138	| Command | Purpose |
   139	|---|---|
   140	| `composer test-file -- <path>` | Run a single test file |
   141	| `composer test-filter -- <pattern>` | Run tests matching a name pattern |
   142	| `composer test-suite -- <name>` | Run a named test suite |
   143	| `composer test-group -- <group>` | Run tests in a PHPUnit group |
   144	
   145	### Choosing the right scope
   146	
   147	1. **Changed a single class?** → `composer test-file` with its test file.
   148	2. **Changed a module?** → `composer test-filter -- ModuleName`.
   149	3. **Unsure which tests cover a change?** → `composer test-filter -- ClassName`.

   153	## 7. Static Analysis Quick Reference
   154	
   155	Run PHPStan via Composer scripts — **never invoke `vendor/bin/phpstan` directly**.
   156	
   157	| Command | Purpose |
   158	|---|---|
   159	| `composer analyze` | Run PHPStan against the codebase |
   160	| `composer analyze-save` | Run PHPStan and write results to `phpstan-result.txt` |
   161	| `composer analyze-clear` | Clear the PHPStan result cache |
   162	
   163	> **Warning:** `tests/phpstan/` contains only a bootstrap constants file (`constants.php`) consumed by `phpstan.neon`. It is **not** a PHPStan runner or CLI tooling directory. Never restore, create, or execute scripts from this folder — always use the Composer commands above.
   164

   166	
   167	## 8. Build Quick Reference
   168	
   169	| Command | Purpose |
   170	|---|---|
   171	| `composer build` | Full build: autoload dump, module docs (keyword glossary, modules overview, API method index, offline event listeners), CTX generation |
   172	| `composer clear-caches` | Clears all framework caches including the dynamic class cache |
   173

   175	
   176	## 9. Developer Tools Quick Reference
   177	
   178	### Interactive Developer Menu
   179	
   180	Launch the menu-driven interface for common developer tasks from the project
   181	root:
   182	
   183	```bash
   184	# Unix / macOS
   185	./menu.sh
   186	
   187	# Windows
   188	menu.cmd
   189	
   190	# Direct (any platform)
   191	php tools/menu.php
   192	```
   193	
   194	If `vendor/` is missing the menu runs `composer install` automatically before
   195	showing any options.
   196	
   197	| Option | Action |
   198	|---|---|
   199	| 1 | Setup local environment (`php tools/setup-local.php`) |
   200	| 2 | Build (`composer build`) |
   201	| 3 | Run tests — sub-prompts for an optional filter pattern |
   202	| 4 | Clear caches (`composer clear-caches`) |
   203	| 5 | Seed test database (`composer seed-tests`) |
   204	| 6 | PHPStan analysis (`composer analyze`) |
   205	| 0 | Exit |
   206	
   207	### Local Environment Setup
   208	
   209	Interactive one-command setup for the local development environment:
   210	
   211	```bash
   212	composer setup
   213	```
   214	
   215	Prompts for database and UI settings, generates `test-db-config.php` and
   216	`test-ui-config.php` from their `.dist.php` templates, creates the database if
   217	it does not exist, imports `tests/sql/testsuite.sql`, and runs
   218	`composer seed-tests` on completion.
   219	
   220	Re-running is safe — existing values are shown as defaults and pressing Enter
   221	preserves them.
   222	
   223	The script can also be invoked directly:
   224	
   225	```bash
   226	php tools/setup-local.php
   227	```
   228	
   229	> **Note:** The generated config files (`test-db-config.php`, `test-ui-config.php`)
   230	> are listed in `.gitignore` and must never be committed.
